note: Integer weights for the encounter tables (game/js/sim/placement/encounters.js). PM_DEFAULT: set by the writer for the PM to change. Read by buildTables; no plugin loads it yet. See docs/systems/DEUS_Encounters.md.
tierGapNote: A table of tier Tn holds rows of tier Tn and below. Index = table tier minus row tier; a row more tiers below the table than the list is long is left out (T0 rows are not in T3 or T4 tables). Entry weight = frequencyWeight x tierGapWeight.

featureOnly.note: DESIGN-D4 sections 4, 5 and 7 item 9 (settled for this lane): elementals are feature-summoned by their element source, never rolled from a tier table. These rows go only to feature tables.
